leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure an Express server to support WebSocket connections
Initialize a WebSocket server instance within an Express application
Implement WebSocket event handlers for client connections and messages
Manipulate WebSocket connections to broadcast messages to multiple clients
Integrate WebSocket functionality with existing Express routes and middleware
Construct a basic real-time chat application using WebSockets and Express
Control WebSocket connection lifecycle including opening, closing, and error handling
